text:
deploy-bot: kicking off staged rollout v5.0.1 -> 12% us-east (commit c7f4d9a)
deploy-bot: release-notes: https://ci.redwood/release/5.0.1 ; highlights: streaming perf, embedding encoder dedupe, routing micro-ops
rebecca: embedding p95 in us-east spiked ~300ms after shift, chat endpoints look fine :thinking:
omid: error rate for embeddings up from 0.1% -> 1.6%, mostly 502s from embed hosts
tara: traces show embed encoder throwing tokenizer OOV on long payloads, weird since no tokenizer change was merged in this commit
infra-bot: note: commit c7f4d9a included a packaging bump that changed container base image (alpine -> slim) (PR #8299)
rebecca: could be image libc change affecting the tokenizer C-extension. we should avoid full-region pin if only embeddings route affected
ish: idea: do a per-route emergency rollback for embeddings route in us-east instead of pinning whole variant. routing supports route-level splits
omid: yes. keep chat and rerank on v5.0.1, move embeddings traffic back to v5.0.0 in us-east only
tara: what's the command? can we do it without touching hosts?
deploy-bot: suggested command sequence:
```
# limit embeddings route in us-east to 0% for v5.0.1
redwood route split --region us-east --route embeddings --from v5.0.1 --to v5.0.0 --percent 100 --force
# pause global percent progression for v5.0.1
redwood rollout set --commit c7f4d9a --global-percent-hold true --reason "partial route rollback: embed tokenizer issue"
```
deploy-bot: executed split at 4932101245, embeddings traffic in us-east routed to v5.0.0 (timestamp 4932101245)
rebecca: metrics: embeddings 95p back to baseline in ~20s; 502s dropped to previous 0.2% :thumbsup:
omid: logging saved: s3://canary-replays/4932101234/embeddings-502s.tar.gz for postmortem
tara: followups: revert packaging bump on a hotfix branch, add a container smoke test for C-extension compatibility, and add an embedding-specific canary probe that exercises long payload tokenization
ish: deploy impact: this is nice because we avoided touching chat paths. ops cost minimal; routing split is hot and quick
infra-bot: updating release notes: "us-east embeddings route rolled back to v5.0.0 due to tokenizer regressions; other routes remain on v5.0.1"
rebecca: decision: partial route rollback in region. hold global rollout until hotfix validated in small-bake (embed-focused). Notify SDK teams about the route split so they can check telemetry
omid: I'll own the hotfix PR and coordinate the embed small-bake in 36h. tagging serving-runtime + infra for image validation
tara: also, add a regression test in the embed integration suite for large-token counts and streaming chunks
deploy-bot: note: thread closed at 4932101259. reopen with `redwood deploy reopen --thread 4932101234` if new signals surface
rebecca: thanks all — nice low-risk containment. we'll post a short postmortem if root cause confirmed.
